character: Lively market town, world capital of mountaineering at the foot of Mont Blanc. Full year-round town with train station, supermarkets, bakery, shops, bars, restaurants, cinema, casino, museums. Brevent-Flegere ski access. La Folie Douce at Le Brevent. Microbreweries, theatre, nightclubs. Aiguille du Midi cable car (3,842m). Montenvers train to Mer de Glace.
dining: La Fruitiere (La Folie Douce Hotel). Le Mayen (modern alpine). Pointe Isabelle (bistro). Bighorn Bistro. The Dainty Pizza. Microbrewery at Big Mountain Basecamp. Dozens of restaurants.
shopping: Full year-round town. Supermarkets, bakeries, butchers, fromagerie, wine shops, sports shops (Snell Sports since 1934), fashion, pharmacy, post office. Weekly market.
apres_scene: La Folie Douce (Le Brevent). Microbreweries. Pointe Isabelle, Bighorn Bistro. Chambre 9 (cocktail bar). DZ Bar. Le Privilege (nightclub).
activities_nearby: Aiguille du Midi cable car (3,842m). Montenvers train to Mer de Glace. Ice skating rink. 2-screen cinema. Casino. Swimming pool. Paragliding, rock climbing, mountain biking. Golf (18-hole).
